title: Rainfall threshold guidance
description: Guidance for a burned area from the geological survey and the weather service: the rainfall intensity thresholds (for example 15-, 30- and 60-minute totals in millimeters) above which debris flows are likely, the current forecast against them, and the suggested level of action. Debris flows follow short intense rain, not daily totals.

examples: Regional Geologic Hazards Team and the Weather Forecast Office
Debris flows likely in the most susceptible basins
A band of heavy showers is expected between 6 PM and 10 PM with peak 15-minute amounts of 5 to 9 mm. The 15-minute threshold may be exceeded.
Consider closing roads below the burn area from 5 PM and preparing evacuation of the lowest homes.
